stack.nuxt_ui: transitive via @narduk-enterprises/narduk-core module (no direct @nuxt/ui dep; UIcon/ULink/UButton/UAlert all in use); reka-ui 2.9.2 is a DIRECT dep used only for ConfigProvider/TooltipProvider in app/app.vue

local_reimplementations.name: MarineStationHistoryTable (StationHistoryTable.vue)
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled CSS-grid header+rows history table with dynamic column count (one column per available metric), overflow-x-auto for mobile; narduk-libs ships no table component to have adopted instead

local_reimplementations.name: MarineStationList (StationList.vue) + 3 item variants
local_reimplementations.notes: StationList.vue (68 LOC) + StationListCardItem.vue (42) + StationListCompactItem.vue (83) + StationListRowItem.vue (70) + StationListEmptyState.vue (7) = 270 LOC across 5 files implementing a 3-variant (cards|compact|rows) collection renderer with a client-side display cap (props.limit, NOT real pagination - just Array.slice) and a shared empty state. This is the single richest 'what should a shared CollectionTable's row-density modes look like' example in lane L1.

local_reimplementations.name: RegionStatsPanel
local_reimplementations.notes: icon+label+value+unit+trend KPI tiles (dl/dt/dd); also contains a literal, non-reactive '2 min ago' text string with no template binding - looks like a stale/hardcoded freshness label rather than a computed one, worth a live check

local_reimplementations.name: MapSidebarFilters
local_reimplementations.notes: largest hand-rolled filter surface across all three L1 repos

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionList (cards|compact|rows variant prop)
top_extraction_candidates.why: the clearest, most deliberate multi-density collection renderer found across all of lane L1 - a single variant prop switching between card grid / compact list / detail rows, each with correct empty-state handling and a client-side display cap. This is close to a ready-made spec for a shared component's density modes.

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable (history/time-series variant)
top_extraction_candidates.why: dynamic-column CSS-grid table with horizontal-scroll mobile handling, backed by a real time-range+resolution+row-cap API contract - the most table-like surface in the entire lane and a strong shape reference for a shared table's 'no sort, no pagination, just a bounded time window' mode

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionFilterBar
top_extraction_candidates.why: largest hand-rolled filter surface in the lane; StationSearchPanel and StationHistoryControls each reimplement pieces of the same search/filter/toggle concept independently

notes: buoys has the richest table/list evidence in lane L1. Good adoption of narduk-charts (Sparkline + StationHistoryChart both correctly wrap NardukLineChart) and AppMapKit, but ZERO usage of narduk-ui instruments (NsFreshnessChip/NsLevelWell/NsRangeBar/NsReadoutTile all 0) despite this being a freshness-heavy marine-status product - status is instead conveyed via hand-rolled '.marine-dot' color classes (dotClass() in StationListRowItem.vue). reka-ui is a direct dependency used only for ConfigProvider/TooltipProvider, independent of the Nuxt UI access that comes transitively through narduk-core. RegionStatsPanel.vue has a literal non-reactive '2 min ago' string that looks hardcoded rather than computed - flagged, not confirmed live.
